findings.title: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to `startOfDay(day)` and then adds one day, so `endOfDay(day)` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day. This breaks the function's contract and will cause incorrect date ranges when used downstream (e.g., `rangeEnd` in `src/range.ts`).

summary.problem: The refactor of `endOfDay` changes its contract, returning the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day.
summary.done_well: The new implementation reuses `startOfDay` to avoid duplication.
